brief.whyLbl: Why the market fell on Friday

why.t: Profit-taking in IT after Thursday's rally: HCL Tech −3.03%, Infosys −2.68%, TCS −2.57% (HDFC Sky, Angel One, Marketcalls).
Brent rose to about $97.3 (+0.8%) on West Asia tension, reviving inflation worries before the RBI policy (HDFC Sky, Marketcalls).
The rupee fell 60 paise to 92.98 per dollar (provisional), its weakest level 93.01 (HDFC Sky).
Markets expect a possible US Fed hike on 8–9 Dec after US core PCE inflation of 3.3%; the US has proposed tariffs of up to 20% on 14 partners including India (HDFC Sky).
Financials and autos were sold: Shriram Finance was the top Nifty loser and Bajaj Auto fell 3.36%; autos fell for a second day (Angel One, Marketcalls).
Despite the fall in large caps, Midcap 100 rose 0.10% and Smallcap 100 0.56%; NSE advances 2,119 vs declines 1,514 (HDFC Sky, Upstox).

news.t: Listed at ₹134 on NSE, 1.47% below the ₹136 issue price; traded around ₹130–135 in the morning (HDFC Sky)
Top Nifty loser; the company called talk of an RBI audit baseless (Marketcalls, Angel One)
Fell to ₹10,485 as auto stocks declined for a second day (Angel One)
Led the IT sell-off after Thursday's rally; closed ₹1,424.10 (Angel One)
Top Nifty gainer at ₹411.45; Nifty India Defence index up 3.33% (Angel One, HDFC Sky)
Hit a 52-week high after raising revenue guidance despite a 31% fall in Q2 profit (Kotak Neo, Upstox)
Record date 23 Dec 2026 for its 1:5 split and 1:3 bonus (Kotak Neo)
Fell after a Supreme Court order on warning labels for foods high in sugar, salt or fat; Nifty FMCG −0.93% (Upstox)

cal.t: India Q2 FY27 (July–September) GDP data (Sylph Corps calendar).
RBI monetary policy meeting; decision on 4 Dec (Sylph Corps, Potoos Research).
US Fed meeting; markets expect a rate hike (HDFC Sky).
